ns2:course.label: Costume Draping
ns2:course.description: Development of patterns for theatrical costumes through advanced draping techniques. Extensive lab work culminating in draping and constructing. 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: THEA 442.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: THEA 442.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Theatre department.
